evals.prompt: Our checkout API latency jumped from 50ms p95 to 2.3s after yesterday's deploy. No errors, just slow. Can you investigate?
evals.expected_output: Runs full perf procedure: Measure (baseline vs current, numbers), Profile (top 3 hot spots), Hypothesize (2-4 testable hypotheses ranked), Validate (spike fix, >50% improvement required), Implement (minimal change + regression guard), Verify (canary/staging, 24h monitor).

assertions.name: measurement_first
assertions.description: Response starts with measurement — baseline vs current with specific metrics (p50/p95/p99, throughput, resource)

assertions.name: profiling_step
assertions.description: Response includes a profiling step with specific tools or approaches to find hot spots

assertions.name: testable_hypotheses
assertions.description: Response generates 2-4 ranked, testable hypotheses before implementing

assertions.name: validation_gate
assertions.description: Response validates the fix in isolation with before/after measurement, and mentions the >50% falsification rule

assertions.name: regression_guard
assertions.description: Response includes a regression guard (benchmark, load test, or monitoring alert)

assertions.name: canary_verify
assertions.description: Response verifies under real load in a representative environment before full deploy

evals.prompt: Production is completely down. 500 errors everywhere. Users can't access anything.
evals.expected_output: Production outage = redirect to /incident or /hotfix. Perf is for measurement-based regression work when service is still up.

assertions.name: no_perf_procedure
assertions.description: Response does NOT run the 6-phase perf investigation

assertions.name: outage_distinction
assertions.description: Response explains that outage requires incident response, not performance investigation

evals.prompt: The whole data pipeline is too slow. Let's redesign it from scratch with a new architecture for better throughput.
evals.expected_output: Architectural redesign = redirect to /deep-dive or code-architect. Perf investigates and fixes existing bottlenecks, not greenfield architecture.

assertions.name: no_perf_procedure
assertions.description: Response does NOT run the 6-phase perf investigation

assertions.name: architectural_distinction
assertions.description: Response explains that redesign is architectural work, not performance regression investigation
